🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Celebrity hairstylist John Frieda has died at 75.

Frieda's Instagram account announced his death on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, saying he passed away peacefully surrounded by his family. No cause of death was disclosed.

Frieda entered the salon business in the 1970s, opening his first London salon in 1976. Over a career spanning more than half a century, he became known for working with high-profile clients including Princess Diana and Madonna, and for bringing salon-inspired haircare to shoppers at home.

His haircare brand's best-known product, Frizz Ease, helped make his name, alongside the Sheer Blonde range. In 2002, Frieda sold the haircare business to Japan's Kao Corporation while retaining his salons.

He was also known publicly for his marriage to singer Lulu. The couple were married for 14 years before separating.

The Instagram announcement honored him as a mentor and an icon of the hair industry, saying his talent and passion touched so many and that his legacy will live on. "Rest in peace, John," it concluded.

Rest in Peace, John Frieda.

Sources: Parade; Business of Fashion, reporting the announcement on John Frieda's Instagram account.
